legend: Bone marrow core biopsy shows sheets of immature cells, consistent with pronormoblasts (<<30256>>). Immunohistochemistry for CD71 highlights nucleated erythroid cells (<<30257>>). Neoplastic cells are diffusely and strongly positive for p53 in a case of acute erythroid leukaemia with a TP53 missense mutation (<<30258>>). Neoplastic cells show a complete loss of p53 expression in a case of acute erythroid leukaemia with a TP53 splice-site mutation; scattered reactive cells in the background are weakly positive for p53 (<<30259>>).
